content.text: Uterine bleeding of abnormal quantity, duration, or schedule
: ovaries produce estrogen but no ovulation = no corpus
luteum formation; unopposed estrogen (from no progesterone) ⇢
: ovulation occurs but corpus luteum does not fully
develop to make sufficient progesterone for 14d prior to menstruation
(never transitions to secretory phase); tissue not favorable for
implantation, difficulty achieving pregnancy; shorter than normal cycles or
: bleeding at the time of ovulation related to sudden
drop in estrogen that occurs mid-cycle (destabilization of lining)
: CBC, iron studies, PT/PTT, progesterone, prolactin, FSH, LFTs
(alternative for patients w/ risk factors for endometrial cancer)
all women >35yo w/ obesity, HTN, DM
